title: review-frontend-code output
description: Output contract for the review-frontend-code Review stage. Workflow engine routes on `verdict`. Validation failure triggers one retry, then human-queue.

verdict.description: Workflow-engine-routable verdict. Function of findings + claims_unverified per references/severity-guide.md verdict matrix.

loop_back_target_stage.description: Required (non-null) when verdict is loop_back. design_ambiguity / bundle_overrun / token_gap flags route to design; everything else routes to implement.

findings.description: One entry per gap. Empty = clean.

rule_violated.description: Identifier from references/review-rubric.md (F1..F12, A1..A9, C1..C5) or 'workflow' for input/contract issues.

evidence.description: Verbatim code snippet OR a [needs verification] tag when confidence is Low.

fix_shape.description: What the fix should look like — component signature, prop type, helper name. Suggestion only; this skill does NOT emit code.

standards_ref.description: Optional published-standard identifier (CWE-###, WCAG #.#.#, OWASP A0#:2021, etc.). Omit rather than guess.

claims_verified.description: Plain-text list of Generate claims the code substantiates.

claims_unverified.description: Plain-text list of Generate claims the code does NOT substantiate. Non-empty forces loop_back or human-queue regardless of finding count.

a11y_verdict.description: A11y is a banking-grade blocker — surfaced separately so the workflow can route on it without parsing findings.

focus_management_evident.description: True only when display/interactive component requires it AND code shows focus moves; null-equivalent (true) for display-only without focus needs.

xss_mitigations_verified.description: True when every dangerouslySetInnerHTML has DOMPurify + // SAFE: comment, or none present.

token_storage_verified.description: True when no localStorage/sessionStorage write of auth-shaped key found.

pii_helpers_verified.description: True when every PII field in input is rendered through its declared helper.

csrf_protections_verified.description: True when every mutation has CSRF protection or is a no-mutation feature.

dependency_additions_detected.description: List of npm imports not in package.json that the reviewer found. Empty when clean.

rules_evaluated.description: Count of distinct rule items (F*, A*, C*) the reviewer evaluated. Banking-grade target: all 26 (12 + 9 + 5).

claims_checked.description: Count of distinct Generate claims the reviewer verified or refuted at step 6.
